# OpenPrinting foo2zjs OPL decoder

This directory contains the complete source needed to build the isolated
Raster Object/OPL decoder shipped with the gateway.

- Source package: Debian `foo2zjs 20200505dfsg0-3`
- Source: `https://sources.debian.org/src/foo2zjs/20200505dfsg0-3/`
- Upstream `opldecode.c` SHA-256: `320ebcb465bfcb1893ce472f8a345a4fc88fa086880e8c1ab190a2a13a8b1107`
- Audited patched source SHA-256: `a894427b9e7e02b940adbaad53041568e507752d11d24b02ac2dcc4cb826575e`
- License: GNU GPL version 2 or later; see `COPYING`

The upstream decoder freed a JBIG state after a plane completed, overwrote the
`JBG_EOK` return value with `fwrite()`'s return value, and then fed record
padding into the freed state. Complete color OPL streams therefore terminated
with SIGSEGV. The two local changes preserve the decoder return code and stop
feeding bytes after the current plane is complete. Both monochrome and four-
plane color streams generated by the Konica Minolta 2480 MF PPD pass.

`bin/linux-arm64/opldecode` was built on the KICKPI K2B Ubuntu Noble test board
and linked against the system `libjbig.so.0`. Its SHA-256 is
`86061fb03f723d9f465bb2c777213455a4cdcbfdf2141d56526dca68a56030c0`.

The decoder is a separate GPL command-line process. Product distribution must
preserve the patched corresponding source and license and still requires legal
review.
